title: Chart quiz #4
caption:
Chart quiz #4. No peeking at the reveal.

Q1: Pullback, or reversal?
Q2: Which line is real support?
Q3: Will this new high hold?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #PriceAction #SupportAndResistance #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Pullbacks, levels and momentum. Question one. A strong uptrend, and now price is dipping toward its average. Is this a pullback, or a reversal? A pullback. Volume dried up on the dip, and it held above the last higher low. A reversal usually breaks that low. Question two. Price is falling again, with three lines drawn underneath. Which one is real support? A, B, or C? B. Buyers stepped in at that level three times before, so traders are watching it. A and C are just lines on a chart. Question three. Price just made a new high. Now check the RSI panel underneath. Will this new high hold, or fail? It failed. Price made a higher high, but RSI made a lower one. That divergence showed momentum fading. It's a warning, not a certainty. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
